$comment: The CONSUMER manifest for the object-reader alignment carry witness (D-FORMAT-MACHO-SECTION-ALIGN-EMITTED-RAW-NOT-LOG2, the read-side half). `dependsOn` a `staticlib` project is what makes this example route its link through an OBJECT READER on every leg: the dependency is built to an archive, the archive is appended to this target's resolveLibraries, and the static-link pull reconstructs its atoms — alignment included, or not. `path` only: plan 06 §5.1 B.7 forbids an example that touches the network.
$commentWhyFourTargets: One manifest, four legs, three readers. The PE leg is the one the fix repairs (`coff_object_reader.cpp` dropped the declared alignment entirely); the two ELF legs and the Mach-O leg exercise the siblings that already carried it, so a regression in EITHER of those shows up here too rather than only in a unit suite. That is the same reason the sweep's unit pins live in all three reader suites.
